nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to the deployer (msg.sender) in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
uint256 battle counter, initialized to 1, incremented in reset and used as randomness seed in calculateWin.
uint256 price a buyer must pay (msg.value >= price) to buy a country.
address[6] array storing the owner of each country slot; zero address means unsold.
uint256 index of the winning country, initialized to 6 (no winner) and set by calculateWin.
uint256 counter of history entries, incremented in addHistory.
mapping(uint256 => address) history of winner addresses per battle id.
mapping(uint256 => uint8) history of winning country/item ids per battle id.
Constructor: sets price and owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function transferring the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function transferring a caller-specified amount to msg.sender.
View getter returning battleCount.
View getter returning countryOwners.length.

View getter returning the countryOwners array.
View function counting how many countries a given address owns.
View function returning true when every country slot is owned.
Payable function buying a country slot for msg.sender after value/price, bounds, emptiness and contract checks.
onlyOwner function that picks a winner via getRandom, transfers the reward and records history.
onlyOwner function resetting win, incrementing battleCount and clearing countryOwners.
Private view randomness helper mixing block data through sha and applying modulo limit.
Private view helper hashing block.difficulty, block.coinbase, now, a blockhash and a wager.

View getter returning historyCount.

View getter returning the stored winning item id for a battle id.

Caller-controlled address used as owner, buyer, withdrawal recipient and isContract argument.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter _price only feeds the price state assignment inside etherKing and should be folded into that function node.
The _amount parameter is only meaningful as the argument of withdrawAmount and should be folded into that function node.
The countryId parameter only indexes countryOwners inside buyCountry and should be folded into that function node.
The _win parameter only feeds the history write inside addHistory and should be folded into that function node.
The _itemId parameter only feeds the history write inside addHistory and should be folded into that function node.
The _battleId parameter only indexes the history mappings inside addHistory and should be folded into that function node.
The local winAddress exists only to be the destination of the external ether transfer and should be merged into that unsafe operation node.
The local reward exists only as the value of the external ether transfer and should be merged into that unsafe operation node.
